This summer, I engaged in a "Conceptual Development" project called BikeCamp Discoveries.  The deeper concept involves merging the idea with Toursanak, SmallWorld, and VitaminAir, whereupon young people internationally can arrive in Phnom Penh and be hosted by a select trained team of young Cambodians.

In short: BikeCamp Discoveries is an outdoor education company based in Rome, NY, USA, dedicated to providing transformative learning experiences for Cambodian youth visiting the United States. By combining bikepacking and off-grid survivalism, BikeCamp Discoveries aims to cultivate self-reliance, environmental and cultural awareness, and a profound appreciation for nature.

When time permits, you can learn more here:
https://bikepaths.org/bikecamp

The photos below represent a report of bicycles collected in Rome.  I've learned that both great used bicycles and suitable gear are plentiful at very low prices through Facebook Local Marketplace. It appears profitable to operate a used-bicycle and outdoor outfitting center if building inventory year round. The greatest expense involves the process of upgrading and repairing only the best quality bicycles. Bicycles used for long distance touring must be high quality and dependable, while a person can begin with the most basic gear.
My present touring bike which I will take to Los Angeles on Sept 9th. Purchased for 75 usd added the handlebars, front and rear racks among other customizations.
The bike I road from Wash DC to Tampa, FL, and then a return from Tampa to Rome NY. Gift of bro. John in Northern Virginia.
The Peuguot purchase in Albania, Jan 2018, for 175 usd, toured through Europe, UK, Cambodia, and across the US twice. Racks have been removed for now.
A nice Marin street bike for 50 usd.  I added the front and rear rack from the Peugeot.  Great fast city bike, but also suitable for road touring.  Not for off-road.

A like-new hardly used import from Germany with a high-end mix-tee frame purchased for 55 usd.  The rubber tires alone were worth the price.  I wanted the hubs and wheels  for the silver bike, so I swapped them out. A great price for the components and frame.
A classic Miyata mix-tee frame, a sweet, fast, city bike with a rear rack and BOB trailer. Like new.
A classic high-end Ross racer for a tall person. Like new.
